_comment: What's new: shown once to each player after an update. Newest first. id must go up by 1 with every new entry. game = page name without .html (farm, race, tycoon ...) or all.

items: Minimap: growing crops go from dark to light green as they grow, gold when ready
Minimap: each of your fields shows a countdown until it's ready to harvest (💧 if some still need water)
After every update, this card shows what changed
Fields split into strips by the seeds you select again (1 = whole field, 2 = halves, 3 = thirds)
Switch vehicles with Tab, the 🔄 Switch button or Triangle on a controller
Combine tank holds one field (240) and unloads into the trailer by itself when full
The truck and trailer park beside the field you're harvesting
Daily missions grow with your farm, and a New missions button appears once they're all done
Shared multiplayer XP stops at level 20; after that everyone levels on their own
The farmhouse opens: kitchen, missions, achievements and your farm record
Grain elevator moved away from the shop; drive the combine there to unload it directly
Extra-wide implements: 7 tiles at once (level 20)
Level-up card lists everything you unlocked and what's next
Tractor and combine drive back to their parking spots when you get out
Fields show their number in the owner's colour
Achievements show progress bars
Fertilizer is sold at the barn again and shared on multiplayer farms
Fertilized soil turns olive-green so you can see what's covered
Pigs, compost tower and the fertilizer seeder upgrade
Kitchen: Make all button
Tractor and combine engine sounds (🔊 button to mute)
Rain no longer freezes the game
